name: India Ramsar Sites September 2026
role: provided ROI dataset (primary water-quality analysis ROI, approved 2026-09-25)
supplied: 2026-09-25, placed in backend/data/ by the project team

Indian Ramsar Sites.shp (+ .shx .dbf .pr.format: ESRI Shapefile with QGIS 3.44 metadata (.qmd, no title/abstract/source)
Indian Ramsar Sites.shp (+ .shx .dbf .pr.note: Same 114 features and attributes as the GeoJSON; geometry within 8 mm of it

field_note: 'officialna' is RSIS 'officialname' truncated by the 10-character shapefile field limit
provenance_finding: Not a 101-site dataset and not a GEE ROI export. Every feature's v_idris, ramsarid, name and area_off equals the RSIS layer ramsar_sdi:features_published (raw copy in boundaries/raw/rsis/); per site the geometry matches RSIS within 7.8 mm (Hausdorff) and area within 0.001 %, i.e. RSIS geometry rounded to 7 decimals. The 3 invalid geometries (2408, 2413, 2548) are the same as in RSIS.
used_as_supplied: The GeoJSON is read as-is: no repair, simplification, buffering or reprojection. A site's features are collected into one MultiPolygon without dissolving. Invalid geometries are rejected, not repaired.
